name: learnloop
description: AI-powered adaptive learning platform with an MCP server

scripts.build: npm run build -w @learnloop/shared && npm run build -w @learnloop/api && npm run build -w @learnloop/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @learnloop/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @learnloop/api" "npm run dev -w @learnloop/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @learnloop/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @learnloop/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
